about_the_game:
Welcome to the battle of the Tree Kingdoms.

Explore the map, claim territory, upgrade your cities, and expand your empire to survive the winter and lead your kingdom to victory! Tree Kingdoms is a bite-sized 4x strategy game where you control the forest to claim land and secure your domain. How will your touch shape the board this year?


Strategic Turn-based action!



You are a Great Spirit of the forest, the plants and trees your subjects - but you are one of many Great Spirits. In the coming year you must strive to assert your domain before the winter comes and your power is diminished, as even spirits cannot control the seasons.



Expand and develop your territory to unlock new units and strategic advantages!
Eliminating your competition will ensure your survival, giving you space to grow as you please. So too with laying down deep roots to tide you and yours over the winter, as even the frost cannot reach so deep. But for many, sometimes it is just enough to survive the year and face a new spring. How will your touch shape the forest this year?



Race against the seasons to secure your victory in this Bite Sized 4x!

Features
=====================================

A bite-sized turn-based 4x strategy game where you must lead your forest kingdom to victory.

What path to victory will you take? Are you an aggressive warlord - dead set on crushing all who oppose you? Or perhaps you prefer a more peaceful victory by digging your roots in deep to the soil.

Perhaps when all is said and done, it is simply enough to survive until the end of the season - and live to grow another day?

  • Explore the map and expand your empire - but be warned, you are not the only kingdom looking to settle in these lands. Enemy tribes are also seeking to establish their empire.

  • Move quickly and decisively as winter is coming soon, you must be victorious before the land freezes beneath you.

  • Choose a path to victory - Complete Destruction, or Peaceful Ruler


Choose your kingdom, and push on to glory!

==============================================
